@s1 stated
  relation "live in"
  role subject "Constantin"
  role destination "Castellon"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "send a package with"
  role subject "the user"
  role object "a package"
  role instrument "Ghita's minibus"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s3 stated
  relation "stop working"
  role subject "Ghita"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s4 stated
  relation "operate"
  role subject "Atlassib"
  role location "Vaslui"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@a1 assumed
  relation "contain"
  role subject "the package"
  role object "approximately 20 kilograms of jars of zacusca and a wedding suit"
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature

@q query
  select ?price
  where match
    relation "cost to send"
    role subject "a package"
    role source "Iasi"
    role destination "Castellon"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@q2 query
  select ?days
  where match
    relation "take to arrive"
    role subject "a package"
    role source "Iasi"
    role destination "Castellon"
    polarity affirmed
  end
